comparison.objective: Cut a cable tie from a cable bundle without damaging insulation.
comparison.physical_skill: Stabilize a rolling bundle while precisely positioning and squeezing flush cutters beside the tie head.
comparison.success_condition: Tie truly severed and off the bundle, no cable nick, cutters returned, bundle retained, and arms clear.
comparison.reason: This is the nearest separation task, but it tests quasi-static cutter closure at a safe cut location. The candidate instead requires coaxial mandrel support, hammer impulse, notch fracture while retaining a threaded coil, and recovery of four free tangs.
